Hi Margo — thanks for the forecast and the clear ask. High-level we have two pragmatic paths that avoid a permanent tier bump:

1) Transient Burst Add-on (recommended)
   - 10-day burst credits purchased up-front covering the estimated peak tokens/throughput.
   - Pricing: estimated $12k for the 10-day window based on your attached forecast (we'll firm after a short usage check).
   - Behavior: traffic routed to your current tier; when capacity approaches the tier ceiling we use burst credits to spill to dedicated hotspots with identical model variants.

2) Feature Repack + Quantized Background Runner
   - Move non-realtime batch embeddings to a quantized runner priced at -40% per-token vs realtime.
   - Keep realtime path on current tier. Requires enabling the runner (no infra change needed on your side).
   - We can bundle this as a pilot package with a one-time configuration fee.

Concession ask for quick procurement: I can propose a one-time onboarding credit to offset the pilot set-up and give you a short-term discount for the first month (to be approved by my manager). If that sounds sensible I'll run this by Sales Ops and send a single-page offer (with numbers and a DocuSign link).

Next step: do you want the stronger safety margin (we size burst credits for 7x) or stay closer to your 6x forecast? If you give me the margin I’ll produce final numbers and a one-page offer.

Best,
Hannah
